title: Optimal Production Planning Under Macroeconomic Regime Switches
summary: We develop a comprehensive mathematical and computational framework for optimal production planning in economies governed by stochastic regime switches driven by a continuous-time Markov chain. The value functions of the underlying stochastic control problem satisfy a weakly coupled system of quasilinear elliptic Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman (HJB) equations. We establish a global multi-regime comparison principle and prove the existence and uniqueness of classical solutions under optimal growth conditions, generalizing the scalar framework to the multi-regime setting.
